subject: Precache holds the assistant renderer closure (AssistantSurface + streamdown + @streamdown/math + KaTeX) within the 5 MB budget; asserted in offline.spec (448db71a)
body: Built from the Vite manifest's static closures (src/offline/sw/precache.ts PRECACHE_ROOTS), not globs; 4.35 MB/171 entries, budget enforced at build. @streamdown/code (Shiki grammars) is runtime-cached on first use. offline.spec checks the precache holds AssistantSurface, ReaderPage, QuestionPage and KaTeX and nothing under /api. A real offline chat render e2e needs a stored assistant thread (LLM) that the local stack can't produce; seg14, if your spec can seed a thread, an offline assertion there would close it.
